reduction of solid method
Any 6 from:
MP1 crush / grind ore / break into smaller pieces / powder
MP2 using a suitable method e.g. pestle and / or mortar,
hammer
MP3 add more reactive element / reducing agent
MP4 carbon / coke / iron / zinc /
aluminium / magnesium / CO / hydrogen
specified
MP5 heat
MP6 In a suitable container (e.g. crucible, evaporating
basin)
MP7 tin displaced / reduced / displacement reaction to make
tin
displacement from solution method
Any 6 from:
MP1 crush / grind ore / break into smaller pieces / powder
MP2 using a suitable method e.g. pestle and / or mortar,
hammer
MP3 add a (dilute) acid
Max 6

MP4 suitable strong acid named (e.g. HCl, H2SO4, HNO3)
MP5 add metal more reactive than tin
MP6 name of metal added specified (e.g. iron, zinc,
magnesium)
MP7 tin displaced / tin reduced / displacement reaction to
make tin
electrolysis of solution method
Any 6 from:
MP1 crush / grind ore / break into smaller pieces / powder
MP2 using a suitable method e.g. pestle and / or mortar,
hammer
MP3 add a (dilute) acid
MP4 suitable strong acid named (e.g. HCl, H2SO4, HNO3)
MP5 electrolysis (of solution)
MP6 specified inert material for electrodes (e.g. carbon,
platinum)
MP7 tin obtained at the negative electrode / cathode

electrolysis of molten ore/oxide
Any 6 from:
MP1 crush / grind ore / break into smaller pieces / powder
MP2 using a suitable method e.g. pestle and / or mortar,
hammer
MP3 heat ore / oxide
MP4 until molten
MP5 electrolysis
MP6 specified inert material for electrodes (e.g. carbon,
platinum)
MP7 tin obtained at the negative electrode/cathode
